purpose: Describe which work the measured Mech compiler emits and which general libraries perform. This is metadata preparation; it admits no sample or chart endpoint.

mech-regexredux-native-sequence.label: Mech AOT with Rust regex 1.13.1
mech-regexredux-native-sequence.mech_compiles: The source pipeline, calls and dependencies for input cleanup, nine counts, five ordered replacements, formatting and output.
mech-regexredux-native-sequence.general_library_performs: Rust regex::bytes builds patterns at runtime and performs matching. Mech's runtime counts its nonoverlapping matches and applies literal replacement bytes.
mech-regexredux-native-sequence.comparison_scope: Complete program and chosen general regex library; this result does not isolate Mech-generated matching performance or establish general numeric performance against V or C.
mech-regexredux-native-sequence.library_scope: Arbitrary caller-supplied byte patterns, subjects and literal replacements. No host regex-redux benchmark executor or recognized DNA workload.

mech-implicit-matrix-native-sequence.label: Mech-emitted matrix arithmetic
mech-implicit-matrix-native-sequence.mech_compiles: The source coefficient function, row/column loops and multiply/divide/add operations into native numeric kernels.
mech-implicit-matrix-native-sequence.runtime_performs: Storage allocation, checked shape boundaries and partition scheduling; it calls the emitted native kernel.
mech-implicit-matrix-native-sequence.scope: The measured implicit-matrix native-sequence path. This does not assert that every general Mech matrix or interpreter path uses the same lowering.

publication_rule: Reconcile these labels against the exact preserved source/compiler/runtime pins of each admitted measured profile before adding them to its source inspector. Preserve earlier measurements. V remains report-only and absent from visualization data.
